scoring_justification: Formation energy recomputed from raw total energies; d-band center compared to paper gold because recompute from PDOS is infeasible in verifier, but result-level compare with tolerance is accepted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold formation energy per formula unit (-1.05 eV) and d-band center (-1.43 eV) reported in the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Formation energy of antiperovskite is -1.05 eV; d-band center of Pd/ae-PdNNi termination is -1.43 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted from the paper (section 2.3, Figures 4a and 4e).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly quoted from the paper's reported values, consistent with public figures.

outputs.description: Total energies of the reference phases and the antiperovskite bulk per simulation cell, used to recompute the formation energy.
The d-band center of the surface Pd atoms relative to the Fermi level.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker recomputes the formation energy from total_energies.json and compares to a hidden reference value. The d-band center is compared directly. Tolerances are set to absorb DFT-implementation spread.

steps.description: Recompute formation energy from total_energies.json and compare to paper gold (-1.05 eV) with tolerance 0.15 eV
Compare reported d-band center to paper gold (-1.43 eV) with tolerance 0.15 eV
